Results.ReviewText: Received as a gift.  Used a couple of times, so far so good.  Need a bigger chimney for the charcoal, as there is a lot of space within the base of the grill and then surface coverage at the top.
Results.Title: Nice Little Grill

Results.ReviewText: This Grill is perfect just like a Weber! My Husband actually made some NY Strips on it today - I love size and height of this one- not to mention the smoking option.  Thanks for another great product Weber- ALSO shout out to your customer service they to are awesome.
Results.Title: Awesome Grill- Love A Weber

Results.ReviewText: Well first thing first. There ain’t nothing else like a Weber charcoal grill. The ash ketch design is absolutely wonderful and safe which is the reason I purchased it. I can now bbq on a windy day at my home that is located in a forest and be worry free from starting a forest fire
Results.Title: Weber charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: A perfect grill for beginning grillers! Easy to assemble. Easy to clean.

Results.Title:

Make sure to purchase the Weber Rapidfire Chimney Starter... just add newspaper and its ready to grill in under 20 minutes.

Results.ReviewText: A bit more refined than the original I purchased in 1982, but still very portable and versatile.  The ash collector and thermometer are great features.
Results.Title: Can't go wrong with the time proven classics!

Photos.Caption: All of this from one batch

Results.ReviewText: I have been using this 3-4 times a week since purchasing it. The 22” is perfect for a smaller family and uses less fuel (charcoal) than the 26”.
Results.Title: 22” is perfect for small families!

Results.ReviewText: Awesome grill! Been wanting a good charcoal grill for quite while now, you can't beat this one. Built to last and it gives such a better taste than cooking on a gas grill. Would highly recommend!
Results.Title: Awesome grill!

Results.ReviewText: I have had a weber grill for over 40 years.  This new weber is my third charcoal weber grill that I have had.  I have had a few gas grills but I will say my best grilling is done on a weber charcoal kettle grill.   My family says my whole turkey that I cook on my weber is the best turkey they have ever tasted.  I have done over400 turkeys for family and friends.
Results.Title: The best turkey grilling ever.

Results.ReviewText: I bought one of these 10 years ago or so when the serial number was 2 digits and still use it. This new verision is awsome. I love the design and its ability to control the heat so well. I have many grills but this one is my favorite to cook on for my family of 4.
Results.Title: My Favorite Go to Grill

Photos.Caption: 12 lbs of beautiful pulled pork smoked on a kettle.

Results.ReviewText: I grew up in the 90's and early 2000's when the bigger the better grill epidemic started. I never considered a kettle until guys at work started talking about it. Well let me tell you the 6 foot long dual functioning smoker/grill i was inspired to buy by my dads and papaws in the past.....well it hasnt had a fire in it since the day my kettle was assembled. I love this little grill!!!
Results.Title: Simpler is in fact better!!!

Results.ReviewText: Have grilled and smoked for decades. This is my first kettle and I’m really impressed at how much temp control you have.  Smoked a rack of ribs and they turned out great!  This is gonna be fun! Big shout out to the ladies in the warranty department, you folks are the best!
Results.Title: Kettle thoughts

Results.ReviewText: Very pleased with your product.  The app is also very helpful.
Results.Title: Novice griller

Results.ReviewText:
Easy setup, cooking area is perfect for a family of 3 with room for additional items needed. 
The ability to adjust airflow from the top and bottom to help maintain temperature (verified using the installed gauge on the lid). The interior hook is great, allows you to hang the lid on the side of the grill during cooking. 
Purchased the 1st of the month and have used the grill 4 times(every weekend). 
Highly recommended the Weber premium cover. Protected from the pollen and recent rain storms
Results.Title: Fantastic grill!

Results.ReviewText: Great product. Cooks great. Plus, when you're done you can close the vents and save the remaining charcoal for the next message.
Results.Title: Great product

Results.ReviewText: Really nice grill and great customer support! I highly recommend getting the chimney starter, it makes getting the charcoal going way faster and easy.
Results.Title: Highly recommend

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble, easy to use, an absolute classic. If you are looking for the perfect burger, this is how your going to get one.
Results.Title: Weber Awesomeness

Results.ReviewText:
Great build quality.
Easy to put together
Cooks great
Results.Title: Great build quality

Photos.Caption: Ring of Fire!  Drumsticks for dinner.
These ribs were great and I used the Weber rib rack which helped a lot.
First time smoking a chicken and won’t be using so much wood next time.  I underestimated how well this kettle works for smoking.  I learned that less is more with poultry and to use fruit wood.

Results.ReviewText: I love my Weber Kettle grill!  The quality is top notch and there is nothing better than enjoying a beer and smelling great tasting food cook on the kettle.  I don’t even use my propane grill anymore.  I really like how Weber has focused on finer details to improve the experience with the premium kettle series.  The hand guard on the lid, handles with hooks for utensils, ash bucket for no mess cooking and cleanup plus the overall design makes this the best charcoal grill for me.  My only grip with this grill is the size and quality of the wheels.  While they get the job done, I think that customers would benefit from larger and higher quality wheels for transporting the grill.
Results.Title: You won’t regret it!

Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber grill. Love it and the app looking forward to grilling for family and friends.
Results.Title: First time Weber owner

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. My only complaint is the lid hook. Just don’t trust it. Going to purchase the bale type holder. For the price of a premium kettle you would think it would be included.
Results.Title: 22 premium kettle

Results.ReviewText: I always wanted a Weber Kettle but never bought on. I finally did and wish I would had gotten one years ago. It is very versatile and cooks evenly. Do yourself a favor and buy one. Best grill I have ever owned!
Results.Title: Best Grill I Ever Owned

Results.ReviewText: This grill is perfect, and I love getting back into grilling some excellent dishes that have incredible flavor and smiles as we enjoy dinner.
Results.Title: Flavor

Results.ReviewText: Very “user friendly” grill.    So easy to use to produce delicious food.   I’ve grilled on all kinds of grills.   This one has been the best and easiest to use.
Results.Title: User Friendly Grill

Results.ReviewText: This Premium Charcoal Grill is probably the seventh or eighth Weber Kettle we've purchased over the years.  Everything is great with one exception.  The ash catcher handle is very very difficult to squeeze in order to remove and empty the catcher.  The previous "twist and drop" catcher handle worked much better.
Results.Title: Changes in ash catcher handle design

Results.ReviewText: My very 1st charcoal grill and I am 60 years old! Always used gas/propane, even out camping. A bit nervous but lots of good tips and ideas from Weber and youtube gurus. First time I made burgers and was absolutely dumbfounded they tasted so good. On to steaks!
Results.Title: Wow!

Results.ReviewText: I love my Weber Kettle!  Already used it a bunch of times grilling and low and slow smoking.  Once I figured out how to manage the temperatures of charcoal it became a breeze.
Results.Title: I love my new Weber Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Great customer service. My handle broke on my kettle and was sent a replacement no problem. Thank you. This is why I continue to invest in Weber products.
Results.Title: Broken handle

Results.ReviewText: This grill is top quality and extremely well made. The cooking consistency is amazing. We truly love this product...
Results.Title: Best grill ever

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for bringing this to our attention! We passed your feedback to our support team and they have reached out to you via email. We look forward to fix this issue and get you back to grilling!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Damaged lid when purchased. Sent a replacement lid opened box damaged also.
Results.Title: Damage

Results.ReviewText: It’s great, helping to Make America Grill Again! Way better than the cheap charcoal grill I used to have. 22” is a good size for cooking with indirect heat. This model makes controlling the temperature and cleaning a breeze. Cooking with a charcoal and wood tastes so much better than propane.
Results.Title: Helping to Make America Grill Again!

Results.ReviewText: If you're reading this, you've likely done a lot of research. Here's my input: always buy a kettle with the ash cleaning system. It's just better. I wish I'd gotten a 26" but only because I use my kettle mostly for smoking. It'd be nice to have more room but this is a preference thing. Overall, I love my Weber kettle. I have some minor issues with the lid not sealing 100% but this doesn't affect my heat too much. The major problem I have with the grill is the leg hardware. Frankly: it's junk. The metal legs are not very strong; the wheels tore up my deck (!) and the front leg plastic cap has already disintegrated. I am likely going to build a custom wood stand for my kettle and remove the legs altogether. The cooking is outstanding (and that's the important part!) and the grill section is high quality. If you want to get into charcoal grilling and don't want to commit tons of cash, buy this grill. It's great for just that. Happy grilling and smoking!
Results.Title: LOVE this grill. However...

Photos.Caption: Smoked BBQ meatloaf turns out great
Works great no matter the weather
No problem holding low and slow temps for 10+ hours for a pork butt

Results.ReviewText: Nothing but good things to say. Bought it as an intro to charcoal having never cooked with it before or owned a Weber product but now use it several times per week for grilling and smoking. This grill can do practically cook anything and will no doubt last years. My only regret is given how much I use it now I should've splurged for the performer model from the start.
Results.Title: Best bang for your buck in BBQ

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
